revision: three-party view label map, revision 3. This file holds the structure of the screen (columns, step columns, the column each step's arrow starts from, states, outcome headlines, countdown, keys, trace, the lenses and the order of the inspector's sections for each) and the screens' own words for the parts and the scenes: the line under a part, the detail line of a part, and the title, the line and the availability of each scene. No part label, party role, stand-in note or button is here: those are in three-party/labels.json, the contract's label map. A listener that serves the screens adds the words of this file to that map in its answer to GET /api/labels, and the page takes parts, parties, timestamp and scenes from that answer.

checkpoint.text: Checks the agent's ATX credential, issues a scoped AAP grant and applies the intent rule to each tool call.

crossing.text: Checks the request as it crosses from the agent's trust domain into the bank's.
crossing.detail: The OpenA2A check covers steps 1 to 5 and 7 of draft-asor-wimse-agent-delegation-chain-03, on a prepared delegation chain with two hops.

record.text: Leaves one signed Action Evidence Package for each action, which anyone can check offline.
record.detail: Checked by the OpenA2A verifier for steps 1 to 6 of the format; steps 7 to 10 are not run, and the timestamp entry is a placeholder.
